crossRefs.note: Then the king’s scribes were called at that time, in the third month, which is the month Sivan, on the twenty-third day…
After these things, when the wrath of King Ahasuerus was pacified, he remembered Vashti, and what she had done, and…
Let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the beautiful…
He came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

people.name: Ahasuerus
people.line: Persian Emperor (probably Xerxes I); husband of Esther

people.name: Esther
people.line: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.

translations.web: So Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus into his royal house in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
translations.bsb: She was taken to King Xerxes in the royal palace in the tenth month, the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
translations.kjv: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
translations.asv: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.
